# Third-Party Test Fixtures (Masters & Layouts)

The binary `.pptx` fixtures in this directory are unmodified upstream test files retained solely for automated SlideMaster, SlideLayout, theme, and placeholder inheritance tests within `@pptxdk/capabilities`.
